unresolved_engineering: Spring end treatments, terminal retention and preload installation
Friction, cap return under load, print fit and physical durability

assembly_audit.boundary: Actual coaxial passages, continuous wall/seat witnesses, head seating, access with upper cap removed, integral roots, fixed-spindle retention, keyed rotor fit/torque witnesses and sampled rigid vertical insertions. Threads are major-diameter envelopes. Printed fits, key backlash, insertion under friction/compliance, screw standard selection, preload, stripping, stiffness and strength need physical qualification.

spring_audit.boundary: Geometric candidate hardware, seats, terminal connections and prescribed flexure poses. End coils/terminal bends are schematic; no supplier selection, elastic equilibrium, preload assembly under force or printed durability qualified.

detent.geometry: Seven 0.9 mm webs, six 1 mm centre-radius U bends, 2 mm print height
detent.force_and_fatigue: UNQUALIFIED: the straight 12 mm cantilever calculation does not apply to this folded spring

engineering_estimates.boundary: Candidate spring estimates only. Folded detent stiffness, holding torque, friction, fatigue and force-driven cap return remain unresolved. Geometry and native motion cannot establish physical function.

intentional_connections.rotor: Drum/hub/travel pin form the lower rotor; RNA gear/input sleeve/click wheel/feed wheel form the upper rotor. A D-key couples the two, with separate assembly and torque witnesses.
intentional_connections.TPU: Neighboring nominal RNA cells, their base roots and clasp roots represent one continuous flexible strip.
intentional_connections.flexures: One fused serpentine flexure depicts prescribed deflection; force and fatigue remain unqualified.
intentional_connections.spring_studies: Native coil solid and its schematic terminals represent one metal torsion spring; their root laps are intentional. Compression spring has two explicit seat washers.
intentional_connections.integral_roots: Lower-body/spindle and cover/detent-anchor features overlap and fuse to one solid each.
intentional_connections.fastener: Only bounded nominal thread envelopes overlap their pilots. Coaxial passages, conical seats, clamped stack and fixed washer shoulder are checked; thread strength and preload are unqualified.

validation_boundary: Focused actual bead/drum, actual rack/gear including shoulder bends, conservative continuous envelopes, central RNA captivity, reusable-clasp fit, native open/closed forward/reverse, cap feed/return, cam clearance, positive travel stops, actual screw passages/seats/wall sections, integral roots, keyed rotor fit/torque and sampled assembly insertion checks. TPU cells and flexure chords are prescribed deformation; native coupling omits physical key backlash and axial float. Springs have explicit hardware solids, anchors and seats; their properties remain unqualified. No force, click acoustics, compliance, strain, snap retention, fatigue, manufacturing, hand-fit or physical-operation qualification.

End-of-feed force transmission and protection against pawl skip or damage under overload
Direct bead capture/retraction, wire pitch fixation, buckling and bend fatigue
Printed fits, fastening, material selection, assembly and durability
